_readme: Edit the values below, then run `node build.mjs` and upload the contents of dist/ to public_html/. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Empty required fields show as yellow placeholders on the site and are listed when you build.
_legalName: REQUIRED. Your registered business name, or your own full name if you run it as a sole proprietor. Must match your Razorpay KYC.
_supportEmail: REQUIRED. Use an inbox you actually read (a Gmail is fine). An @rankveer.com address will NOT receive mail until the domain's DNS is sorted.
_supportPhone: Optional. Shown on the Contact page if filled, e.g. +91 98765 43210
_businessAddress: REQUIRED. Payment gateways check that the website lists one.
_grievanceOfficerName: REQUIRED. Name of the person handling complaints, as required under India's IT Rules. Can be you.
_jurisdictionCity: REQUIRED. City whose courts govern the Terms, usually where you are based, e.g. Lucknow
_playStoreUrl: Leave empty until the app is live - the site shows 'coming soon' instead of a broken link.
